scripts.dev: bun build ./index.html --outdir ./dist --watch & bun run copy-assets --watch & bun server.js
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build ./index.html --outdir ./dist --minify && bun run copy-assets && bun run inject-static-tags
scripts.inject-static-tags: sed -i 's#</head>#<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="./icon-192.png"><link rel="manifest" href="./manifest.json"><script src="./coi-config.js"></script><script src="./coi-serviceworker.js"></script></head>#' dist/index.html
scripts.copy-assets: mkdir -p dist/assets/books && cp -r assets/books/* dist/assets/books/ 2>/dev/null || true && mkdir -p dist/assets/cm-chessboard/pieces && cp -r node_modules/cm-chessboard/assets/pieces/* dist/assets/cm-chessboard/pieces/ 2>/dev/null || true && mkdir -p dist/assets/cm-chessboard/extensions/markers dist/assets/cm-chessboard/extensions/arrows && cp node_modules/cm-chessboard/assets/extensions/markers/markers.svg dist/assets/cm-chessboard/extensions/markers/ 2>/dev/null || true && cp node_modules/cm-chessboard/assets/extensions/arrows/arrows.svg dist/assets/cm-chessboard/extensions/arrows/ 2>/dev/null || true && cp -r public/* dist/ 2>/dev/null || true
